scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a conventional home purchase loan for $335,000 with a 30-year term. I haven’t requested preapproval. Could you tell me the current status or outcome of my application? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for reaching out. Your application for a conventional home purchase loan in the amount of $335,000 with a 30-year term has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have any other questions about your loan details, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for letting me know my loan has been approved—that’s a relief!

Could you tell me what my assigned interest rate is, and the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your assigned interest rate for this loan is 6.625%. The total loan costs associated with your loan are $5,741.70. If you need clarification about any of these figures or would like more details, just let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you let me know if this loan is flagged as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, or if there are any negative amortization features on it? Also, has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution since approval?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage. It does not have any negative amortization features. According to the record, your loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution since approval.

dialogue.user: That’s good to hear—thank you for clarifying those points. One last question: can you tell me what my debt-to-income (DTI) ratio was for this application, and if that affected my approval in any way?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio at the time of your application was in the range of 30% to less than 36%. The loan record does not include information about how your DTI ratio specifically affected the approval decision.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all the clear answers. I have all the details I need now.

<Satisfied> — I feel satisfied with this interaction because all my questions were answered promptly, and the information was communicated in a way I could understand. The agent was professional and clear, though there was limited context about how my DTI factored into approval (but I understand that isn’t in the record). I appreciate the thoroughness and courtesy throughout.
